main_text.head: TYPVS SECVNDÆ partis Logicæ.
main_text.l: Secunda Logicæ pars versatur circa propositionem, quæ consideratur vel
Quantitatis: Vniuersalis: Definita. Indefinita. Particularis. Singularis.
Modalis: Pura. Secundaria, quæ vel Primaria. Exclusiva. Exceptiva. Restrictiva.
Dissentanea, quæ est oppositio, quæ: Contradictoria. Contraria.

page.notes: The page is a fold-out style tree; brace and bracket structure is reconstructed from the drawing. Some small words in the diagram are uncertain, notably the quantity labels and the "Vniuersalis" and "Modalis" group labels, and the left-hand vertical label.
